data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Insert the Bug Classification step into fix-bug/SKILL.md AFTER Phase G (Anti-Pattern Sweep & Test Index) and BEFORE Phase H (Commit and Close). Do NOT modify Phase G or Phase H content.

## Position
- After the last content of Phase G (Test Index Check / Step 2)
- Before '## Phase H: Commit and Close'

## Required content in the new section

### Section header
'## Bug Classification Step (/dso:fix-bug)'
Or equivalent explicit name that is NOT 'Phase G' (that's already taken by Anti-Pattern Sweep).

### Dispatch logic
- MANDATORY on every closure where --reason starts with 'Fixed:'
- SKIP when --reason starts with 'Escalated to user:'
- Dispatch: bug-classifier-haiku agent with inputs: (1) registry slug list from plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.json entries[*].slug, (2) bug title and description, (3) one-line fix summary
- Output validation: trim whitespace, byte-for-byte compare against registry_slugs union {'uncategorized'}; ANY deviation = schema failure

### Tag write on success
.claude/scripts/dso ticket tag <BUG_TICKET_ID> bug-type-<slug>

### Failure handling
Schema failure OR timeout OR dispatch error:
- Write BOTH: bug-type-uncategorized AND bug-type-classifier-failed-<reason> where <reason> in {timeout, schema, dispatch-error}
- Retry tag writes once on failure
- On second tag-write failure: post comment recording the failure, continue to Phase H

### MAX_AGENTS exemption
Classifier dispatch is exempt from MAX_AGENTS/SESSION_USAGE throttle gating — it is a single short haiku call that must run even when MAX_AGENTS=0. Document this explicitly in the step.

## Done when
bash tests/scripts/test-fix-bug-classification-step.sh exits 0.
data.title: [GREEN] Add Bug Classification step to plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md between Phase G and Phase H
